body:
Integrator, 01:21 MST. #2751 round-1 rework is pushed at a2e163b106 (on story-1728-slice2b, up to date with main). CI is running.

- F1: `aida verify` is a Write again (verify_cmd.rs). Main had no read arm for top-level verify, only `db block verify`.
- F2: story_1728_policy_parity_tests checks 2080 invocations against main's legacy answers for stakeholder, auto-push and role-restore skip: every path plus every single-flag variant that parses. The fixture was captured from origin/main a27fe3fc76. Mutation-checked: reverting F1 fails it on 4 rows. The other 2076 rows already matched, so there are no further policy slips.
- F3: requester_intake_is_coerced_by_the_add_handler, through add_args_for_dispatch, the handler's only decode.
- F4: requester_intake_check refuses undecodable add args, with a test.
- F5: ac394c52 / aca82bf2 / ac5ac281 anchors are in place. `aida criteria` shows them traced in the worktree.
- F6: the PR body has the throwaway-commit diff stat. It shows queue_cmd_args.rs +3, queue_cmd.rs +1 and the golden snapshot, and no hot files.
- F7/F8: not fixed, per your ruling. I softened the body's leak-guard claim to match F8.

New finding: BUG-2189 (filed, high). `aida export`, `aida report ai-integration` and `aida config format X` panic at parse, because a local `format` arg collides with the global `--format`. It reproduces on the live a27fe3fc76 and on the pre-slice-1 97987f04b5, so it predates STORY-1728. I left it out of this PR.

Housekeeping: my worktree ~/ai/aida-story1728 and lease 01a14e902cf0 had been removed by the time your mail arrived. I recreated it with `aida session start --reuse-branch --force-claim`, now lease 01a15314; the force-claim was needed because the spec sits in needs-attention from the #2727 round-1 verdict. Nothing was lost, since everything was pushed.

Gate: check-ci-fast 30/30, `-- story_1728 stakeholder_cli_policy` 25/25. You re-review F1–F6 and ship on PASS; I won't ship it.
subject: #2751 round-1 rework pushed at a2e163b106
